name: 2g MKX Disposable *LIMITED EDITION* WC26 - London Pound Cake - Indica
description:
Inspired by the world’s favorite game, this limited-time release brings international flavor straight to the lineup. Three countries. Three unique flavor experiences. From Spain to the USA to the United Kingdom, each strain delivers its own signature profile — no passport required. Step up, tap in, and take your taste buds for a spin around the world.

London Pound Cake delivers a rich, dessert-inspired experience designed for deep relaxation and smooth, flavorful enjoyment. Sweet notes of strawberry, creamy vanilla, and fresh baked cake create a decadent inhale, while calming full-body effects help melt away stress and tension. This indica-forward strain offers a euphoric yet mellow experience, making it the perfect choice for winding down and settling into a peaceful state of mind.
Flavor Notes: Strawberry, Cake, Vanilla
